minute_correlation.histogram: cap_iter_ms complete-iteration histogram; only full one-second bins inside each UTC minute/window are used; P99 is a coarse [lower, upper) bucket, not an exact quantile. Counter deltas are nearest sampler-boundary approximations; whole-window WAL deltas above are exact windowed evaluator output. pg_waits is sampled event-type concurrency, not duration or WALWrite/WALSync event attribution.

pg_stat_io_full_snapshot_interval.note: Pre/post PGSS and pg_stat_io snapshots span setup/warmup/measurement/drain, not the exact 1800 s effective window.

pgss_strict_attribution.reason: Post-only rows have no captured pre baseline; no valid positive matched delta rows.
